cost: Let n be token count after preflight. Both small branches use O(n^2) walk work with n<=64 and O(1) cycle-phase auxiliary storage. Large annotation calls use at most 4n walk steps then optional O(n) reversed adjacency/BFS. Large conversion calls use at most 2n head transitions and O(n) color storage, allocated on every n>64 cycle-phase entry; no reverse rows or queue. Conversion separately retains its heads Vec. Diagnostic strings add error-path allocations. Parsing, normalization and conversion edits have their own costs; no whole-module linearity claim follows. CoNLL-U parsing/projection costs O(B) over admitted input bytes; refresh stages an O(R) row-index buffer before atomic derived-view publication. This correctness repair can add transient memory and allocation; no refresh speedup is claimed.
description: Tagged gate family retains each caller's ordered preflight and diagnostics. Annotation keeps original walks for n<=64 and a 4n walk budget before reverse-head BFS for larger inputs. Conversion keeps original walks for n<=64; larger inputs use functional-graph colors: root is completed (2), unseen nodes become active (1), a path reaching completed nodes is recolored 2, and revisiting active nodes reports the current ordered start. Earlier completed paths leave no active nodes, so the least nonterminating start is preserved, including tails. Reverse-head reachability is the shared mathematical observation, not a runtime BFS dependency of conversion. Local differential tests and restricted cross-gate joins remain separate evidence.

The production joins are parse/normalize -> annotation gate and selected conversion edits -> converter gate. There is no production call from one gate to the other. Independent harness joins share only a finite head vector with lawful token fields, matching root conventions and matching admitted local constraints; outputs are projected to acceptance or first root-unreachable token. Source-local baseline equality tests and this restricted cross-gate observation are different relations. Algorithm library ownership remains unchanged.

CoNLL-U bytes -> Doc lexical scan -> per-sentence refresh -> selected conversion edits -> tree_gate is the actual representation/gate boundary. A parse success alone does not imply a tree: raw malformed heads can project to zero while the gate rejects them. On refresh error, prior sent/words remain together while caller raw edits remain. The permissive training reader resets multiword-range state at every blank separator. After gate preflight, successor[0]=0 and successor[i]=head[i] give acceptance iff every token has cycle_id[i]=cycle_id[0]; the first error is the least token outside that basin, including tails. This independent test adapter preserves one-based token coordinates and does not replace the production gate.

Wave27 child english-lexical: Tag and ptag call dict/hash/gram; ptag uses TnT prior only unknown words. Morph's UD/AGID/rule priority interacts with lexgen src flags and record order: changing a/r/u alters preferred analyses. tok spacing bits are not exact whitespace; consumers cannot infer original byte offsets from detokenize. text order is 1-based while array positions and dictionary indexes are 0-based. udreg validates selected enum features, so upstream Feats::parse unknown-dropping cannot become a complete annotation gate. Existing conllu callers supply Sentence/Token to learning/generation.

Wave27 child english-structure: Heads use root0 and1-based word coordinates; Graph truncates heads to u16, while parser/UD use usize. Ud children returns0-based child indices. GNode lemma references global dictionary or local graph heap; Store fingerprint binds global IDs but not arbitrary target serde schema. annotate repairs tree whereas kbest/complete/explain/Model.encode do not; treating them as identical is invalid. Expert consumes conllu Sentence, not Graph directly; callers must preserve tags/features/relations when adapting. Construct callbacks must return enough dependent entries and valid renderable heads.

Wave27 child annotation-orchestration: ann.rs is an existing cross-group gate/type dependency, not duplicate ownership. main and batch share Outcome::add_patch_reply/finish; llm direct fixed+variable concatenation differs by two separating newlines from codex message-block join. hints advise only; repair precedes draft gates; optional post-gate FEATS replacement is not re-gated.

Wave28 child formula-syntax: Generated enum order must match canonical arrays. Stack reversal preserves expansion order. Printer relax adapters prevent unknown swallowing groups and aligned swallowing brackets; optional rbrack and trailing-row compensation preserve parser structure. Span quotient cannot validate original coordinates.
inverse: In U of tagged lawful calls and Result observations, the candidate inner complement excludes acceptance of a preflight-valid root-disconnected head component, reporting a later unrooted token when an earlier tail enters the same cycle, and a cycle diagnostic masking an earlier Count/Form/Head/Registry or converter root-label error. It also excludes claiming both APIs accept the empty vector: converter accepts it while annotation reports Roots(0). These exclusions describe the relation; negative fixtures only sample it.

For tagged result y, retain every record sequence, root/head vector, registry state and conversion history satisfying that gate's ordered relation. Cycle(k) constrains earlier eligible tokens to terminate and k not to terminate after preflight; it does not identify the cycle vertices or discarded fields. Successful gate observations forget lexical values and edit history. Cross-gate projection further merges different error vocabularies; no unique reconstruction is claimed.

An unedited accepted Doc determines the original bytes through text(); a projected Sentence or gate Result admits many raw documents. Failed refresh preserves derived state only, not a reverse edit of raw rows. Functional components retain more information than gate acceptance; an adapter must project deliberately.
limitations: Claims concern the cycle phase after unchanged preflight. Annotation's walk/BFS policy and conversion's walk/color policy must match the merged sources. Arbitrary edit semantics, normalization, linguistic accuracy, I/O, panics and allocation failures remain outside normal-return guarantees. Current evidence is linked separately from the historical fd540 transfer epoch.
Finite observations and partial syntax do not establish a universal semantic proof.
state: For each gate and admitted call, the complete Result is the baseline Result: same acceptance, first error kind, word index and text. Every head entering cycle detection is in range. A token reaches virtual root iff reversed-head reachability marks it; the reported failed token is the minimum unmarked token, which can be a tail entering a cycle. Annotation Count/Form/Head/Registry/Roots precedence and converter parse/range/root-label/root-count precedence remain distinct.
